event_name: Date 08 July 2018 Time 18:20 2018 BRITISH GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 July 2018 The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 51 & 52) and heard the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 10 collided with Car 11 in Turn 17.
offence: Involved in an incident as defined by Art 38.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: A time penalty of 5 seconds is imposed after the race (5 seconds added to elapsed race time). (2 penalty points awarded, 4 points in total for the 12 month period)
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence, heard from the driver of car 10 (Pierre Gasly), the driver of car 11 (Sergio Perez) and the team representatives. The Stewards felt that Gasly's maneuvers were generally reasonable, and that he was attempting to make a good racing pass. Perez left his sufficient room throughout. However, Gasly touched the sausage kerb at the apex of turn 16 which caused him to collide with Perez. This subsequently forced Perez off the track on driver's left before turn 17 and severely compromised his ability to race through turns 17 and 18, and Gasly was thus able to pass Perez. The Stewards determined that Gasly was wholy or predeominantly to blame, and while the collision was light it led directly to the pass. Therefore the Stewards ordered a 5 second penalty. All
title: Doc 56 2018 British Grand Prix Offence Car 10 Causing A Collision With Car 11
